node.statement: Meaning of triangulation: for any complex K and C^1 triangulation f:K→M supplied above, GT-munkres-edt-def-8.1 makes f a map |K|→M (class C^1 simplexwise), and GT-munkres-edt-def-8.3 says precisely that such a triangulation is a homeomorphism of |K| onto M.
